critical_code_review_comments: trade_analyzer.py is clean, well-documented, and correctly separates unmetered single-asset valuations from paywalled full analyses. Quota burn happens AFTER successful build (line 464), which is the correct ordering.
_ensure_analyzer_quota correctly handles both str and ObjectId user['_id'] formats (line 65) and auto-resets on year rollover (period_key comparison).
Paywall 402 response shape is consistent with compare_paywall: detail.code='upgrade_required' — good pattern reuse.
value-pick endpoint correctly validates 'round' (line 281) and uses extrapolation for rounds >15 (line 228), preventing KeyError crashes.
Scoring scarcity map (POSITION_SCARCITY) treats LW==RW and LD==RD — good handling of position aliases.
Salary-retention cost formula (amount * FAAB_PER_DOLLAR / 1_000_000) documented inline as heuristic — appropriate for a v1 model.
_value_side silently skips invalid ObjectId or missing players (line 358-360) — may mask client bugs. Consider returning an 'unresolved' list in response for client-side diagnostics (non-blocking).
